building: AEUST Chengqin / Cheng Chih Building (誠勤大樓)
source_epoch: Representative exterior around 2021-01-12; not a present-day survey or complete linked complex
units: millimetres for display/printing only; no measured metres or 1:N scale

plan_ratio_constraints.basis: Approximate pixel proportions of official 4F diagram; no dimensioned metric scale

height_basis: Exterior height/length approximately 0.91 selected from photos 0078/0080 and 12 visible floor rhythms, with perspective uncertainty; not derived from a standard floor height. Roof boxes about one typical visual floor; their depth is explicitly estimated.
roof_box_policy: Two boxes, one at each end, wholly within end-core XY footprints. No unknown rear wing; small rooftop equipment omitted.

connector.footprint_basis: Approximate official 4F right-hand curved link outline, simplified and explicitly cut between its two open line endpoints toward Yuanzhi; its depth and vertical alignment are modelling estimates, not survey data

coordinates: X along main long axis; photographed classroom front is -Y; +X is the curved link toward Yuanzhi. This is a local model frame, no geographic direction claim. Main building x=-80..80.
facade_policy: Photographed -Y central slab uses 8 simplified bay groups x12 floor rhythms; positions are approximations, not surveyed window counts. The plan constrains both long edges and end cores. Unseen +Y details are omitted; no mirrored front facade.
print_policy: Solid exterior, shallow chamfered recesses, integrated 3mm printing base; no hollow interior, unsupported fine railings, small equipment, sign text, mullions, exposed basement podium or unknown canopy.
source_rights: No third-party photos, floorplan raster, or webpage captures are redistributed in package.
status: Review candidate only; not published, not physically printed, no G-code/slicer validation.
